FN-Y4SS622-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 87
Committee: Ports, Waterways, and Intermodal Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Transit
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/13/2024
House Bill 87 as introduced would authorize an airport authority to make debt and equity for the
activities of any business organization of which the authority is a member. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
Page 1

FN-Y4SS622-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 87
Committee: Transportation and Energy Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/15/2024
House Bill 87 as passed the House of Representatives would authorize an airport authority to
arrange debt and equity financing for the activities of any business organization of which the
authority is a member. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.

House Bill 87
Committee: Transportation and Energy Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/21/2024
House Bill 87 as reported by the Committee on Transportation and Energy would authorize an
airport authority to arrange debt and equity financing for the activities of any business
organization of which the authority is a member. This bill would not otherwise affect state or
local funding.
